# Veep

> Independent businesses and lean funds hire Veep for senior operators, playbooks, and technology built to grow revenue, expand margins, and withstand scrutiny. Scoped in 72 hours. Started in under 10 days. 30-day guarantee.

Veep is an operating partner platform, not a marketplace, staffing firm, or consulting body shop. Senior operators, repeatable playbooks, and operator-governed AI workflows (Agent Teams) deploy against a defined business outcome across finance, GTM, operations, product, people, technology, and strategy.

## Offers (public)

- Advisory — from $3k/month
- Sprint — from $25k/scope
- Operator — from $15k/month
- Pod — from $30k/month
- Interim Leadership, Managed Operating Partnerships, and Operator-Governed Agent Teams (scoped to the mandate)
- Portfolio Roster — $75k/year (lean PE / family offices / holding companies / independent sponsors; company mandates billed by SOW)
